text: Aesop, who wrote the fables, being then at Sardis upon Croesus's invitation, and very much esteemed, was concerned that Solon was so ill- received, and gave him this advice: "Solon, let your converse with kings be either short or seasonable." "Nay, rather," replied Solon, "either short or reasonable."
author: Plutarch
speaker: Aesop
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
